svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-mess-dress-female-officer-sleeve-braid","name":"Women's USAF-style mess dress: officer sleeve braid overlay (1/2 in, 2 1/2 in from the sleeve end)","size_in":{"w":26.2099,"h":33.26},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2620.99,3326],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-female. Braid 0.5 in wide, its edge nearest the sleeve end 2.5 in from the sleeve end (cut parallel to the cuff) per CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1; general officers wear 1 1/2 in (separate overlay). Braid tone: sampled from CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) rendered at 3x, Fig 4.6 PDF p64 (p.36) braid 2.3,33.1,86.2 / 2.7,31.9,84.3; Fig 4.1 PDF p54 (p.26) 2.1,32.3,83.6; Fig 4.7a PDF p73 (p.45) 2.1,32.4,84.6 against coat 0,40,101 (the figures draw a tonal braid, ~0.72x the coat luminance); drawn in the figure's line structure, 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch, but lighter than the figure: the tonal band repeats C/Col Doran's \"too close to the jacket colour\" (mess dress braid #0b1f5e, 1.1x the coat luminance, 2026-10-12) and the flat #2149a0 (5.3x) was \"too light\" (2026-10-14), so lines #1e3c82 (3.6x), gaps #12286a (1.9x), edge #0a1740 on the coat #001c52, band mean 2.5x, the geometric mean of the two rated values.","anchors":{"top_center":[1310.4972866030091,0],"bottom_center":[1310.4972866030091,3326],"center":[1310.4972866030091,1663],"left_edge":[0,1663],"right_edge":[2620.9945732060182,1663]},"landmarks":{"sleeve_braid_right":[[59.8,2999.7],[396.5,2974.2],[396.5,2924],[59.5,2949.6]],"sleeve_braid_left":[[2558.7,2999.5],[2224.5,2974.2],[2224.5,2924],[2558,2949.3]]},"landmarks_note":"polygons are [[x,y]...] in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-mess-dress-female","dimensions":{"sleeve_braid":{"rule":"lower edge parallel to the drawn cuff edge and 2.5 in from it (CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1), measured perpendicular to the cuff edge;
